text.en: Aim at an enemy to view its health and other critical information in the scope.

Intrinsically <overload/>Anti-Overload.

Hits apply <arc/>Jolt.

Aiming at a target for 0.5 seconds highlights them and reports their Health and Shield percentages, Distance, and Power Level into the scope.

Maximum Highlight Range of 150 Meters.
